gaps_reported_by_model: The five material amounts (boric acid, chromium oxide, copper oxide, UCTE electricity, tap water) are printed as 'confidential'. The excerpt gives no numbers for them at all; they are entered as free parameters with wide bounds and are determined by the calibration step, not by the report.
The report gives no process emissions for this dataset ('No process emission data are available' in the BAFU metadata); only the calculated waste heat is listed.

The bounds attached to the confidential rows are not from the report. They are deliberately wide search ranges (0.001-1 kg for the salts, since the product is 1 kg of mixed salts; 1e-4 to 5 kWh; 0.001-100 kg of water).
